title: The Last Salute
plot_overview: This documentary chronicles the fighter aircraft’s final chapter in the Indian Air Force, highlighting stories from generations of fighter pilots who flew it and offering a focused look at the aircraft’s long service and the people connected to its history.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy aviation history and military documentaries centered on pilots’ experiences; Not for you if you prefer fictional stories, character-driven drama, or broader action.
review_summary: Pros: aviation history; pilot perspectives; national context | Cons: limited plot detail; documentary focus
